Milwaukee Brewers stage thrilling comeback to take Game 2!
The Milwaukee Brewers erased an early 4-run deficit to stun the Tampa Bay Rays 5-4 in a Game 2 thriller! Sal Frelick sparked the rally with a game-tying blast before Cooper Pratt delivered the go-ahead RBI single in the 7th. With Aaron Ashby locking down the final five outs, Milwaukee takes a commanding 2-0 series lead heading into Tampa Bay!
